caption: The drawing depicts four equally sized squares arranged in a grid with two rows and two columns on a beige or off-white background. The top left square is a dark brown color and contains a pattern of small white evenly-spaced dots with occasional white and pink flower-like shapes. The top right square is a deep blue color, featuring three white spiral or circular dot patterns located in the upper right, center, and lower right areas of the square. The bottom left square is also deep blue, displaying several small white and pinkish circular motifs with outward-pointing lines, distributed irregularly across the surface. The bottom right square is pink with a dense pattern of small, lighter pink and white dots spread across the entire surface.
title: Materials from Patchwork Quilt
